purpose: Verify that HR-EIS accepts and executes operations within employee-centric HR service scope (service records, leave, appraisal, LTC, CPDA, audit).
preconditions: Authenticated user in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Execute supported in-scope operations: query service record, submit leave request, view audit trail.
expected_result: Operations are accepted and processed within HR-EIS domain boundaries.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS remains limited to its defined scope and rejects attempts to execute external domain functions (e.g. direct payroll run, bank wire transfer).
preconditions: Authenticated user in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Attempt to invoke external domain operations or non-HR endpoints via HR-EIS.
expected_result: HR-EIS rejects the request as unsupported or outside module scope (404 Not Found or 400 Bad Request).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS permits actions when the actor holds the required Fusion RBAC role.
preconditions: Authenticated user with HR Administrator role.
action_or_input: HR Administrator accesses employee service record maintenance function.
expected_result: Action is authorized and permitted by RBAC (200 OK).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS blocks actions when the actor lacks the required Fusion RBAC role.
preconditions: Authenticated user holding only regular Employee role.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to invoke administrative service record creation endpoint.
expected_result: HR-EIS blocks the action with 403 Forbidden; prior state is preserved.

purpose: Verify that under the Employee role, a user can view their own service record in read-only mode.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with existing service record.
action_or_input: Employee queries personal service record view.
expected_result: HR-EIS displays the user's own service record in read-only mode without edit controls.

purpose: Verify that under the Employee role, an employee cannot view another employee's service record or HR data.
preconditions: Employee A and Employee B exist; authenticated as Employee A.
action_or_input: Employee A attempts to retrieve Employee B's service record by employee ID.
expected_result: Request is refused with 403 Forbidden; other employee's data is withheld.

purpose: Verify the stated exception that additional access requires another explicitly authorized role (e.g. Employee who is also HOD).
preconditions: User holds both Employee and HOD roles; departmental requests pending review.
action_or_input: User accesses departmental approval requests under authorized HOD role context.
expected_result: Access is permitted under the additional authorized role, while personal employee view remains read-only for own data.

purpose: Verify that an employee service record includes appointment details, department, designation, service history, leave balances, and retirement status.
preconditions: Employee service record maintained in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Retrieve service record by employee ID.
expected_result: Service record payload explicitly includes appointment details, department, designation, service history, leave balances, and retirement status.

purpose: Verify that HR Administrators are permitted to create or modify official employee service records.
preconditions: Authenticated HR Administrator user.
action_or_input: HR Administrator submits create or update payload for an employee service record.
expected_result: HR-EIS validates and persists the creation/modification (200 OK / 201 Created).

purpose: Verify that Employees are prohibited from altering or creating official employee service records.
preconditions: Authenticated regular Employee session.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to POST a new service record or PATCH an existing official service record.
expected_result: Request is rejected with 403 Forbidden; official records remain unaltered.

purpose: Verify that valid consistent updates to employee service records succeed and preserve data integrity.
preconditions: Existing service record; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: HR Administrator updates service record attributes with valid data.
expected_result: Update commits successfully and all related fields remain consistent.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS prevents partial updates from corrupting employee service records, rolling back on error.
preconditions: Existing service record; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: Submit update payload with a valid field change combined with an invalid relation that fails database constraints.
expected_result: Transaction is rolled back completely; no partial field changes persist; prior valid record is preserved.

purpose: Verify that a leave request specifying leave type, duration, and justification is accepted for submission.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with available leave balance.
action_or_input: Submit leave request with valid leave_type, duration, and justification.
expected_result: Validation passes and leave request is accepted (201 Created).

purpose: Verify that a leave request missing leave type, duration, or justification is rejected before acceptance.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit leave request omitting justification field.
expected_result: Submission is rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request); request is not accepted.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS accepts a leave request when duration is within balance and employee meets eligibility.
preconditions: Employee has 8 days of Casual leave balance.
action_or_input: Submit Casual leave request for 3 days.
expected_result: Balance and eligibility validations pass; request is accepted for approval routing.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS rejects leave requests where requested duration exceeds available leave balance.
preconditions: Employee has 2 days of Casual leave balance.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit Casual leave request for 4 days.
expected_result: Request is rejected before acceptance with insufficient balance error (400 Bad Request).

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS rejects leave requests where employee is ineligible for the requested leave type.
preconditions: Probationary or ineligible staff category for Sabbatical leave.
action_or_input: Ineligible employee attempts to submit Sabbatical leave request.
expected_result: Request is rejected with eligibility failure error (400 Bad Request).

purpose: Verify that department-level approval requests are routed to Head of Department (HOD) where applicable.
preconditions: Departmental employee submits leave request requiring departmental review.
action_or_input: Submit request and verify initial routing destination.
expected_result: Request is routed to HOD approval queue for that department.

purpose: Verify that non-teaching staff approval requests are routed to Registrar where applicable.
preconditions: Non-teaching staff employee submits administrative HR request.
action_or_input: Submit request and verify routing destination.
expected_result: Request is routed to Registrar approval queue per non-teaching routing rules.

purpose: Verify that faculty-level or final authority approval requests are routed to Director where applicable.
preconditions: Faculty member submits request requiring executive approval.
action_or_input: Submit request and verify routing destination.
expected_result: Request is routed to Director approval queue.

purpose: Verify that when a leave request is approved, HR-EIS updates the employee leave balance automatically.
preconditions: Employee has 10 days Medical leave; pending 3-day Medical leave request.
action_or_input: Approving Authority approves the leave request.
expected_result: Leave balance is automatically reduced from 10 to 7 in the employee service record.

purpose: Verify that when a leave request is rejected or cancelled, leave balance is not deducted.
preconditions: Employee has 10 days Medical leave; pending 3-day Medical leave request.
action_or_input: Approving Authority rejects the leave request.
expected_result: Leave balance remains 10; no deduction is applied for unapproved leave.

purpose: Verify that all leave transactions (submission, approval, rejection, cancellation) are permanently logged.
preconditions: Leave request processed through submission and approval.
action_or_input: Query audit logs for the leave transaction ID.
expected_result: Immutable audit entries exist recording submission, approving actor, timestamp, and balance adjustment.

purpose: Verify that yearly appraisal submission is accepted when submitted within configured submission window.
preconditions: Configured submission window is currently active (today >= window_start and today <= window_end).
action_or_input: Employee submits yearly appraisal form payload.
expected_result: Submission is accepted with status 'Submitted' (201 Created).

purpose: Verify that yearly appraisal submission is rejected when submitted outside configured submission window.
preconditions: Configured submission window deadline has passed (today > window_end).
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit yearly appraisal form.
expected_result: Submission is rejected with error (400 Bad Request or 403 Forbidden) indicating window closed.

purpose: Verify that HR Administrator can assign reviewer(s) for appraisal evaluation.
preconditions: Submitted appraisal in Pending Reviewer Assignment state; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: HR Administrator selects and confirms reviewer assignment.
expected_result: Reviewer assignment is recorded and appraisal becomes available in reviewer queue.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized users cannot assign appraisal reviewers.
preconditions: Submitted appraisal in Pending Reviewer Assignment state; authenticated regular Employee.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to invoke reviewer assignment endpoint.
expected_result: HR-EIS blocks the action with 403 Forbidden; reviewer assignments remain unassigned.

purpose: Verify that appraisal workflows pass through designated authorities for review and finalization in configured order.
preconditions: Appraisal assigned to reviewer; final authority configured.
action_or_input: Assigned reviewer submits evaluation ratings, and appraisal advances to final authority for closure.
expected_result: Appraisal workflow follows configured sequential order through evaluation and finalization.

purpose: Verify that finalized appraisals are archived in the employee service record.
preconditions: Appraisal finalized by final authority.
action_or_input: Query employee service record history.
expected_result: Finalized appraisal report is archived and accessible in the employee's historical service record.

purpose: Verify that appraisal records cannot be modified after closure.
preconditions: Finalized and closed appraisal record.
action_or_input: Attempt to edit, patch, or delete the closed appraisal record.
expected_result: HR-EIS rejects the request with 403 Forbidden or 400 Bad Request; record remains immutable.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports LTC Advance requests submitted using prescribed forms.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee eligible for LTC advance.
action_or_input: Submit LTC advance request containing prescribed form fields.
expected_result: Request is accepted and recorded as Submitted for HR verification.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports LTC Reimbursement requests submitted using prescribed forms.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee with journey completed.
action_or_input: Submit LTC reimbursement request containing prescribed form fields and tickets.
expected_result: Request is accepted and recorded as Submitted for HR verification.

purpose: Verify that HR Administrator verifies documentation and eligibility before an LTC request enters approval routing.
preconditions: Submitted LTC request awaiting verification; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: HR Administrator validates documentation and block year eligibility, marking request verified.
expected_result: Verification is recorded and request enters approval routing in Pending Current Authority state.

purpose: Verify that an LTC request whose documentation or eligibility cannot be confirmed does not enter approval routing.
preconditions: Submitted LTC request with incomplete documentation; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: HR Administrator records verification unconfirmed.
expected_result: Request does not enter approval hierarchy; request is retained with verification audit record.

purpose: Verify that an approved LTC claim is available to the Accountant for HR-EIS-side financial settlement processing.
preconditions: LTC claim approved by designated authority; authenticated Accountant user.
action_or_input: Accountant opens approved claim queue and records settlement processing.
expected_result: Approved claim is accessible to Accountant and settlement processing is recorded.

purpose: Verify that an LTC claim that has not received final approval cannot be processed for financial settlement.
preconditions: LTC claim in Pending Approval state; authenticated Accountant user.
action_or_input: Accountant attempts to record settlement processing on the unapproved claim.
expected_result: HR-EIS rejects the action (400 Bad Request); claims must be approved before settlement.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS records and links LTC payment status with payroll or finance systems without modifying payroll rules.
preconditions: Settled LTC claim with payment confirmation.
action_or_input: Link payment status to payroll interface.
expected_result: Payment status reference is stored in HR-EIS while external payroll rules remain unmodified.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS retains full audit history for rejected or returned LTC requests.
preconditions: LTC request rejected or returned by authority with review remarks.
action_or_input: Query audit log and request history for the rejected/returned LTC request.
expected_result: Complete audit history containing original submission, verification details, and decision remarks is preserved.

purpose: Verify that a CPDA request including purpose, amount, and supporting documents is accepted for submission.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee eligible for CPDA.
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request with purpose, valid amount, and attached supporting documents.
expected_result: Validation passes and request is accepted with status Submitted / Awaiting HR Verification.

purpose: Verify that a CPDA request missing purpose, amount, or supporting documents is rejected before submission acceptance.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request omitting amount (or supporting documents).
expected_result: Submission is rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request); request is not accepted.

purpose: Verify that HR Administrator verifies CPDA claims before approval routing and verified claims enter the approval route.
preconditions: Submitted CPDA claim awaiting verification; authenticated HR Administrator.
action_or_input: HR Administrator verifies claim details and confirms verification.
expected_result: Verification is recorded and claim advances to Pending Current Authority in approval hierarchy.

purpose: Verify that an unverified CPDA claim does not enter the approval route.
preconditions: Submitted CPDA claim awaiting verification.
action_or_input: Authority attempts to decide claim before HR Administrator verification has occurred.
expected_result: HR-EIS blocks the action (400 Bad Request); unverified claim cannot be decided by authority.

purpose: Verify that Accountant processes approved CPDA claims in HR-EIS and records disbursement details.
preconditions: Approved CPDA claim; authenticated Accountant user.
action_or_input: Accountant records disbursement details (amount disbursed, voucher number, date).
expected_result: Disbursement details are saved on the claim record and status transitions to Disbursed.

purpose: Verify that CPDA disbursement details recorded by Accountant are kept permanently auditable.
preconditions: Disbursed CPDA claim in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Query audit logs for the CPDA disbursement transaction.
expected_result: Full audit entry exists showing actor, timestamp, disbursement details, and previous claim history.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports the 'Approved' outcome for routed HR requests.
preconditions: Request in Pending Current Authority state.
action_or_input: Authorized authority executes Approve decision.
expected_result: Request transitions to Approved state.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports the 'Rejected' outcome for routed HR requests.
preconditions: Request in Pending Current Authority state.
action_or_input: Authorized authority executes Reject decision with comments.
expected_result: Request transitions to Rejected state and workflow terminates.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS supports the 'Forwarded to next authority' outcome for multi-tier routed HR requests.
preconditions: Multi-tier request at intermediate authority stage.
action_or_input: Authorized authority executes Forward decision.
expected_result: Request transitions to Pending Next Authority and is queued to the next authority.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS prevents manual bypass or alteration of configured workflow order.
preconditions: Request currently pending Stage 1 authority review.
action_or_input: Attempt to manually force state to Approved or skip Stage 1 authority.
expected_result: HR-EIS rejects the bypass attempt with 400 Bad Request or 403 Forbidden; workflow order is strictly enforced.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS generates notifications for request submission, approval/rejection/forwarding, pending reminders, and policy updates.
preconditions: Active notification triggers in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Trigger submission and approval events.
expected_result: Notifications are generated and exposed through dashboard feed and official email delivery interface.

purpose: Verify that every HR transaction is logged with actor identity, timestamp, and action performed.
preconditions: HR transaction executed in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Inspect the audit log entry created for the transaction.
expected_result: Audit entry contains non-empty actor identity, ISO timestamp, and description of action performed.

purpose: Verify that audit logs are immutable and cannot be updated or deleted.
preconditions: Existing audit log record in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Attempt to execute PUT, PATCH, or DELETE operation on the audit log record.
expected_result: Request is refused (403 Forbidden or 405 Method Not Allowed); audit record remains unaltered.

purpose: Verify that audit log access is permitted to authorized roles (HR Administrator) for compliance monitoring.
preconditions: Authenticated HR Administrator user.
action_or_input: HR Administrator queries audit log records.
expected_result: Access is permitted and authorized audit records are displayed (200 OK).

purpose: Verify that audit log access is restricted and prohibited for unauthorized roles.
preconditions: Authenticated regular Employee user.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to query audit log records.
expected_result: Access is denied with 403 Forbidden; audit records are not disclosed.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS exchanges and records payment, disbursement, or accounting status for approved LTC/CPDA claims with payroll and finance systems.
preconditions: Approved claim with external integration payload received.
action_or_input: Record incoming disbursement status reference from payroll/finance.
expected_result: Status is recorded in HR-EIS without taking ownership of external system execution semantics.

purpose: Verify the boundary exception that HR-EIS does not execute external payroll, accounting, or bank-disbursement operations.
preconditions: Authenticated user in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Attempt to trigger external banking ledger or direct bank disbursement from HR-EIS.
expected_result: Operation is rejected/unsupported; HR-EIS does not execute external financial transactions.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS exchanges identity and role-consistency information with other Fusion modules and synchronizes integration data in real time where configured.
preconditions: Configured Fusion IAM integration.
action_or_input: Query user role context and trigger integration synchronization event.
expected_result: HR-EIS consumes consistent identity and role information in real time as configured.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS consumes assigned roles controlled by institutional authorities.
preconditions: Institutional authority assigns role via platform RBAC.
action_or_input: Authenticate as user with newly assigned role and access HR-EIS.
expected_result: HR-EIS correctly recognizes and applies the assigned role permissions.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS does not expose routine HR-request actors as authorities for role assignment or reassignment.
preconditions: Authenticated regular Employee or Approving Authority in routine request processing.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign or reassign administrative or authority roles via HR-EIS endpoints.
expected_result: Request is refused with 403 Forbidden; routine HR actors cannot assign or reassign roles.

purpose: Verify that access to sensitive HR-EIS data is permitted to authorized roles.
preconditions: Authenticated HR Administrator user.
action_or_input: HR Administrator accesses sensitive master employee service records.
expected_result: Access is granted (200 OK) with full authorized data.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized access or data modification to sensitive HR-EIS data is prevented.
preconditions: Authenticated user without authorized role (or unauthenticated actor).
action_or_input: Attempt to query or update sensitive employee master records.
expected_result: HR-EIS denies access with 403 Forbidden; no sensitive data is disclosed or modified.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS does not modify payroll rules.
preconditions: Authenticated user in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Attempt to invoke endpoint or action to modify external payroll calculation rules.
expected_result: HR-EIS rejects or disallows operation; external payroll rules cannot be modified.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS does not modify institute salary structures.
preconditions: Authenticated user in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Attempt to invoke endpoint or action to modify institute salary grades or pay structures.
expected_result: HR-EIS rejects or disallows operation; salary structures remain untouched.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS generates/records notification events while treating dashboard and email infrastructure as external delivery boundaries.
preconditions: Notification event triggered in HR-EIS.
action_or_input: Process notification event in HR-EIS.
expected_result: Notification event is generated and recorded in HR-EIS and handed to external dashboard and email delivery paths.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS offers Casual, Restricted, Medical, Earned, Vacation, and Sabbatical as supported leave request types.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee accessing leave application interface.
action_or_input: Query available leave types in leave application view.
expected_result: The six supported leave types (Casual, Restricted, Medical, Earned, Vacation, Sabbatical) are available for selection.

purpose: Verify that HR-EIS rejects leave requests submitted with unsupported or arbitrary leave types.
preconditions: Authenticated Employee.
action_or_input: Submit leave request specifying leave_type='CompensatoryOff' (unsupported in HR-EIS).
expected_result: Request is rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request) stating unsupported leave type.

purpose: Verify that Accountant verifies financial correctness according to configured rules before recording financial settlement for approved claim.
preconditions: Approved LTC or CPDA claim with valid bills; authenticated Accountant user.
action_or_input: Accountant performs financial correctness verification and commits settlement processing.
expected_result: Financial correctness check succeeds and settlement processing is committed successfully.

purpose: Verify that if financial correctness cannot be confirmed (e.g. calculation discrepancy or entitlement mismatch), settlement processing is blocked.
preconditions: Approved LTC or CPDA claim with financial discrepancy; authenticated Accountant user.
action_or_input: Accountant identifies discrepancy during correctness check.
expected_result: Claim settlement processing is blocked or flagged; claim is not committed as settled without resolution.
